text: The reputation score mechanism serves a discriminating function, separating malicious actors from simple mistakes and protecting workers and verifiers against fraudulent requesters and badly designed requests.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation

abstract: The reputation score mechanism helps discern malicious actors and simple mistakes. It also protects workers and verifiers from fraudulent requesters and suboptimally designed requests.
